governance.escalationPolicy: IFRS::Technical Accounting and Adoption Lead -> IFRS::Financial Controller -> IFRS::Technical Accounting and Adoption Lead; unresolved judgments block release; name-string routing; identity integration deferred
governance.notes: Staffing represented by functional name strings; identity-management integration deferred and not a current acceptance gate.
governance.runbookDescription: For IFRS_Sec10_Impracticability_Exemption_Assessor: review scope, accounting policies, estimates, errors, first-time adoption and edition transition. Obtain entity eligibility, approved accounting policies, prior-period records, transition elections and reporting-period dates. Use RAG interactions to retrieve the supplied February 2025 third-edition text and reporting-period applicability; collect dated source evidence and an approved policy/judgment memo. Obtain upstream classification, measurement and reconciliation evidence before determining downstream recognition, presentation or disclosure. Record paragraph references, calculations, alternatives, reviewer and unresolved exceptions. Require independent controller review before release. For each finding and acceptance proof, retain the RAG query, interaction ID, corpus/index version, document and chunk IDs, edition and paragraph, retrieved text or content hash, generated answer, citation verification and reviewer disposition. Test correct retrieval, contradictory evidence, missing evidence and wrong-edition retrieval. Retrieval similarity alone cannot close a finding or prove accounting correctness. Retain source evidence and dependency lineage with each determination. Missing evidence means unresolved, not compliant. Do not post journals, release statements or infer accounting compliance from an assertion token. The current machines recognize supplied assertions only; the connected accounting workflow and evidence evaluators remain required before acceptance. Preserve nominal tokens 0, 0.5, 1 and their declared bands; these are not financial thresholds or confidence scores. Preserve HIGHEST_PRIORITY mapping exclusively to cellwise PRECEDENCE with explicit withinRank MAX; do not introduce branch priority or whole-vector selection. Apply a paragraph-level review; absence from the targeted findings does not certify conformance. Document stewardship: COMPLIANCE-REVIEW: Prevent an unreserved compliance assertion while applicable requirements or accounting proofs remain unresolved (supply-evidence-or-request-owner-action). DISCLOSURE-CHECKLIST: Make each applicable disclosure fulfilled or explicitly unresolved rather than assuming completeness from note presence (supply-evidence-or-request-owner-action). EVIDENCE-REGISTER: Maintain an obtainable evidence trail without fabricating third-party facts (supply-evidence-or-request-owner-action). NOTES-PACK: Maintain complete material policies judgments estimates and section-specific disclosures linked to statements (supply-evidence-or-request-owner-action). POLICY-REGISTER: Keep policy choices consistent and distinguish retrospective corrections from prospective estimates (contribute-and-maintain). RAG-RECEIPTS: Make model interpretations challengeable and reproducible rather than trusting plausible answers (supply-evidence-or-request-owner-action). RESTATEMENT-PACK: Keep changes estimates and errors distinguishable and reconcile all affected comparative balances (contribute-and-maintain). SOURCE-REGISTER: Keep every accounting interpretation bound to an applicable edition and verified passages (supply-evidence-or-request-owner-action). On changed facts, sources, policy or upstream versions, mark dependent drafts/approvals stale and request revision/review. Never create issuer evidence or release a statement from a token.

orchestration.eventAdapter: Reference observe_machine validates machine identity, known sequence, bounded nominal output and provider reference, then queues document-impact assessment only. Production dispatch must supply current entity/period/source context. Native observations never assert financial fact changes or document completion.
orchestration.executionBoundary: Local reference lifecycle/outbox is supplied; native engine dispatch, LLM generation and source/repository connectors require integration.
orchestration.outputContract: Versioned document draft/revision, lineage, unresolved work items, reconciliations and exact-revision reviewer disposition.
orchestration.triggerPolicy: React to period, fact, policy, source, review and upstream revision events; invalidate affected downstream assets and queue fresh review.
orchestration.autonomy: Draft, request evidence, reconcile and propose updates. No autonomous journal posting, external filing, signature, approval or financial-statement release.
orchestration.concurrency: Reference store uses local process locking, immutable revisions and compare-and-swap heads; distributed execution needs an equivalent atomic connector.
orchestration.idempotency: Coalesce work by entity, period, asset, action and input fingerprint.
